text:
I have read your post and it’s not clear to me whether you want to continue the gradual process or not, I understand that you want him to be able to come but for what reason? What is you plan for the future in Israel?
They will not extend his visa while he is abroad if he has no plans of making Israel a center of his life meaning staying here at least 9 months during visa year, if he went for a short visit while his visa was expired this is something else… therefore in order to give you the best options please explain your situation
